column3: but the chest was empty.\nSomeone had been here\nbefore us.{end_wait}
but found nothing.\nOnly dust and the smell\nof old smoke.{end_wait}
but there's nothing\nunusual about it.\nNothing you can see.{end_wait}

This rock was blown
here from the volcano!{page_break}It sparkles like a gem.
Mama says it's a piece
of the burning mountain.{end_wait}
If only these rocks were\ngems. We could leave this\ngray place.{end_wait}

The other sparkling
rocks crumbled to ash.{page_break}But this one, from the
roof, is still whole.
I'm keeping it.{end_wait}
Fine, mister. Let me\nsee that rock. Don't\ndrop it.{end_wait}
My neighbor's smirked\nsince the eruption, like\nhe knows something.{end_wait}
Hey, mister. Is it\nworth it, leaving home\nto see the world?{end_now}
Then I'll go too\nsomeday. I'm not staying\nin a town that burns.{end_wait}
Oh... Then why would\nanyone leave at all?{end_wait}
Maybe my neighbor's the\nthief... He's always\nout after dark.{end_wait}
I wonder{pause_20_skippable} what the\nworld looks like beyond\nthese gray, ash-lit hills.{end_wait}
Is it just me, or is\nsomething missing from\nmy house?{end_wait}

Ever since the eruption,
Grandpa keeps checking
what was stolen.{page_break}He doesn't see that we
had nothing worth taking.
Not anymore.{end_wait}
Could they be thieves?\nGod, this is no good.{page_break}I don't know who I\ncan trust anymore.{end_wait}
You never bought me a\nsingle thing worth\nstealing!{end_wait}
Someone has to help\n{actor_name:3}. He's just a boy,\nand he's alone out here.{end_wait}

My husband, the mayor,
refuses to believe a
Vaulter did this.{page_break}But until the rod turns
up, {actor_name:3} can't go
home to Kalay.{end_wait}
I'd help {actor_name:3} myself,\nbut I'm too old to chase\nthieves.{end_wait}
{actor_name:3} has a gift.\nIt isn't a pleasant one.\nWant to know what it is?{end_now}
Then I'll keep it to\nmyself. Some things\nare better left unsaid.{end_wait}
Don't lie to {actor_name:3}. He\ncan hear what you really\nthink, and he will know.{end_wait}
Yes. I... I have strange\npowers. They have never\nmade me any friends.{end_wait}
You have them too,\ndon't you? I can feel it.{end_wait}
What? My power{pause_20_skippable}...\nIt's called Psynergy?\nI never knew it had a name.{end_wait}
We're alike, you and I...\nI think I can trust you\nwith this.{end_wait}
I am troubled. Master\nHammet's rod was stolen\nright out from under us.{end_wait}
Will you help me get my\nmaster's rod back? I\ncan't do it alone.{end_now}
I see. It is a lot to ask\nof a stranger. I\nunderstand.{end_wait}
Truly? Will you help me\nfind the rod?{end_now}
Forgive me. I shouldn't\nhave asked.{end_wait}
Thank you. With you, I\nbelieve we can recover\nthe rod.{end_wait}
Your names are...?{end_wait}
{actor_name:1} and {actor_name:2}.\nI am {actor_name:3}. I'm\nglad you came.{end_wait}
My gift frightens you,\ndoesn't it? Everyone\nflinches when I look.{end_wait}
Am I really{pause_20_skippable}...\nthat frightening?\nTell me honestly.{end_now}
{actor_name:3} took\n{actor_name:1}'s hand and went\nvery still.{end_wait}
{text_effect:4}Ahh! Get out of my\nhead, {actor_name:3}!!\nStop it!{end_wait}
So, {actor_name:1}... what\nabout you? Could you read\n{actor_name:2}'s mind?{end_wait}
Oh? You're going to help\n{actor_name:3}? Good. He needs\nit.{end_wait}
Thank you. Truly.{end_wait}
Please look after\n{actor_name:3}. The world isn't\nkind to boys like him.{end_wait}
Really? You'll help\n{actor_name:3} find the rod?{page_break}I'm so relieved. Thank\nyou.{end_wait}
You're helping {actor_name:3}?{page_break}You don't look like much,\nbut at least he won't\nbe alone.{end_wait}

Since you're helping
{actor_name:3}, I'll tell you
something.{page_break}{actor_name:3} can talk with
animals. They don't
frighten him like we do.{end_wait}
Hey! I felt that...\nSomething crawling around\nin my head. Stop it.{end_wait}

Maybe they'll find our
family urn while they
look.{page_break}It held my mother's
ashes. Thieves have no
shame.{end_wait}
They look dependable,\nI suppose. {actor_name:3} is\nlucky to have them.{end_wait}
I wonder what animals say\nwhen nobody's around.\nMaybe they know who did it.{end_wait}

Master Hammet isn't the
only one they robbed.{page_break}We lost everything worth
selling, in the middle
of a disaster.{end_wait}

They took our best
blades while the mountain
burned.{page_break}All I have left is
scrap. I'm sorry.{end_wait}

They didn't touch our
house, but I'm still
furious.{page_break}When we find them, they
will pay for every
stolen thing.{end_wait}
Maybe they spared us\nbecause we had nothing\nworth carrying off.{end_wait}
You came in today, did\nyou? Be honest with me.{end_now}
